latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fcvt.s.d $f0, $f8; fcvt.s.d $f1, $f9; fcvt.s.d $f2, $f10; fcvt.s.d $f3, $f11; fcvt.s.d $f4, $f12; fcvt.s.d $f5, $f13; fcvt.s.d $f6, $f14; fcvt.s.d $f7, $f15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'fcvt.s.d $f0, $f8; fcvt.s.d $f1, $f9; fcvt.s.d $f2, $f10; fcvt.s.d $f3, $f11; fcvt.s.d $f4, $f12; fcvt.s.d $f5, $f13; fcvt.s.d $f6, $f14; fcvt.s.d $f7, $f15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
